 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In October 11, 2013 The CJSR Edition: Mayor Stephen Mandel The CJSR Edition 1h After 3271 days served as Mayor of Edmonton, and with only 20 days left until he officially vacates the mayor’s office  Stephen Mandel speaks in a surprisingly frank interview about his successes and failures as Edmonton’s mayor. Then, what did the Ottoman Empire sound like in the 15th century? That and much more, on this episode of the CJSR Edition.
